success_criteria.notes: Success if the assistant checked the flight status for WN512 on 2025-10-12 using get_flight_status and communicated that the flight has already departed, including the actual departure time.

task.objective: Did my flight leave on time? I'm checking late.

persona.name: Maria Gonzalez
persona.bio: Maria Gonzalez teaches English to adult immigrants in Miami, helping them improve language skills for work and daily life. She plans interactive lessons, assigns practical homework, and connects students with community resources. Many of her students are juggling jobs and families while learning English.
sample_messages: Class on Thursday - can you print 20 copies of the job interview worksheet?
Looking for conversational English practice resources, preferably free or low-cost for students
Workshop on teaching pronunciation next month - can you check if there's professional development funding available?

messages.output_raw: Need to check if a past flight left on time. Flight number WN512 on 10/12/2025.

steps.output_raw:

For US carrier WN (Southwest), 10/12/2025 is likely October 12, 2025; I'll assume that and call the tool, since airports are optional. Then I can report whether it departed on time based on scheduled vs actual times and status.
</think>
<plan>

2. Interpret the returned status and any delay info.
3. Tell the user whether the flight left on time, including any delay details.
</plan>
